explanation: A title used to show respect and reverence toward God, who is the supreme authority and source of all power.
To be modest and not arrogant, acknowledging one's own limitations and dependence on God.
To be calm and free from anxiety or disturbance, often associated with inner peace and harmony.
In this context, it refers to a person's inner being, emotions, thoughts, and will.
A metaphor describing a child who has stopped nursing and is calm and content in the mother's arms, symbolizing trust and rest in God's care.
The name of God's chosen people in the Old Testament, also used as a metaphor for believers who seek God and His promises.
Expectation and confidence that God will fulfill His promises and give strength, comfort, and salvation.
